steps.title: Commas without converting
steps.text: `formatNumber` works on the digits as text: a regular expression finds every place that has complete groups of three digits to its right.
steps.textZh: `formatNumber` 把数字当作文本处理：用一个正则表达式找出右边正好是若干组三位数字的位置。

steps.title: Why the input is a string
steps.text: A `Number` holds whole numbers exactly only up to 9007199254740991. Past that, digits are lost as soon as the value becomes a `Number`, while the string keeps them all.
steps.textZh: `Number` 只能精确表示不超过 9007199254740991 的整数。超出之后，值一变成 `Number` 就会丢掉数位，而字符串会把它们全部留住。
steps.actionLabelZh: 比较一个 20 位的数字

steps.title: Intl.NumberFormat is for people
steps.text: `Intl.NumberFormat` formats for any locale. By default it keeps at most three decimal places and drops trailing zeros, where `formatNumber` keeps the digits exactly as given.
steps.textZh: `Intl.NumberFormat` 能按任何地区的习惯格式化。它默认最多保留三位小数，并去掉末尾的 0；`formatNumber` 则原样保留所有数位。
